payload.title: work-on-the-line cold read ran on role aliases; (e) answered hedged
payload.body: The LOOP COLD READ ran through completion(model=default|smol), which resolve to anthropic/claude-opus-5-5:high and anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 (the tool refuses exact model ids). Both answered (a)-(d) as required with quoted lines. On (e) haiku said no record can be missing; opus said none is by design but added that lacks checks only local branches and records/ and depends on the integrator running gather. Answers saved under /tmp/judge-speed-plan-line-cold-read/work-on-the-line/. The file-ops dimension (static, unchanged) still says commit main => green, which the loop texts now override for a bound plan.
